newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to auction 150 bln drs of 7-yr FRN June 26.
newsitem.headline: Greece to auction 150 bln drs of 7-yr FRN June 26.

text.p: Greece will auction 150 billion drachmas of seven-year floaters on June 26 and cut its spread over the benchmark 12-month T-bill by 50 basis points to 0.80 percent, the finance ministry said in a statement.
The ministry will also slash the spreads on three- and five-year floaters by 10 and 40 basis points to 0.20 percent and 0.40 percent, respectively, from June 9, it said.
The 50 basis point cut on seven-year FRN spreads goes into effect on June 9, it added.
